items.title_en: BCI With Virtual Reality for Stroke Rehabilitation: A Crossover Study
bullets_zh: ClinicalTrials.gov研究NCT07374276评估一项交叉设计的运动想象BCI结合虚拟现实卒中康复方案。
该试验旨在判断增加MI-BCI-VR训练是否能改善卒中后手臂和手部功能恢复。
其意义在于将脑机接口反馈与沉浸式VR观察相结合，探索神经康复路径。
bullets_en: ClinicalTrials.gov study NCT07374276 evaluates a crossover motor-imagery BCI plus virtual-reality protocol for stroke rehabilitation.
The trial asks whether adding MI-BCI-VR training improves arm and hand recovery after stroke.
It matters as a neurorehabilitation approach combining brain-computer interface feedback with immersive VR observation.
items.brief: 评估运动想象BCI结合VR促进卒中后上肢康复的临床试验。
items.brief_en: A clinical trial testing motor-imagery BCI with VR to improve post-stroke arm and hand recovery.
items.raw_excerpt: The goal of this clinical trial is to investigate if training sessions of motor imagery associated with brain-computer interface and motor observation through virtual reality (MI-VR-BCI) can help to improve arm and hand recovery after a stroke. The main questions to answer are: * Can adding MI-BCI-VR sessions improve upper limb movement? * Can it help stroke survivors perform daily activities more
